component.name: Deskboard
component.summary: Turn your files and folders into beautiful, customizable workspaces with widgets and notes next to them.

description.p: Deskboard brings productivity and personalisation inside the file explorer you work in, turning any folder into a board.
Arrange files freely, bring notes and widgets next to them, and open everything directly from your board. Everything stays local and synced with your actual files.

ul.li: Style your board with wallpapers, decorations, and multiple themes.
Add links, tasks, timers, Pomodoro, voice notes, and more.
Set the vibe with a music player (MP3, YouTube, Spotify), images, and other widgets.
Pin live websites or browse the web through the website widget.
Personalise icons with custom images or rich file previews.
Pop out widgets and files into overlay windows.
Includes DAX, an optional AI agent that can search, analyse, organise, and edit hundreds of files and widgets, and run locally.

description.p: Whether you are a professional, student, developer, gamer, or aesthetic lover, Deskboard has something for everyone.

ul.li: New themes: 8 Bit, Liquid Glass, Minimal
